{{Top|leg}}
'''Jerev''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] settlement on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]] that was located near enough to the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] equator to be affected by electromagnetic discharges from a debris ring that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the planet.
